items.rationale: A1/A2/C2: Cozonac is universal cross-generational Romanian food vocabulary: DEX/DOOM, AGERPRES household-recipe evidence and current AGERPRES/PRO TV holiday coverage are independent signals. A3/A4/A7: its sweet leavened dough, walnut/cocoa/rahat and Easter/Christmas claims are source-backed; ingredient and holiday relations are specific. A5/A6: no boundary trigger or approved Contexto duplicate. C1/C5: concrete dish with one dominant standalone nominal sense; a fixed argot phrase does not compete. C3/C4: 24 recognizable incoming neighbors, zero lint findings, 2,289 reachable; Făină and Nucă rank2, Desert5, Pască10, Cacao16, Zahăr26 and Ou38. C6: .9737 clears usor. Refute-first, Unt is Rece504 and aluat/stafide/rahat/vanilie/Paște/Crăciun are unknown. Those gaps do not outweigh independent defining flour/walnut plus category, pastry and cocoa routes. Promote without a human-enjoyment claim.

The normal target still has independent cheese, dessert, dough, egg and cozonac routes, so promote with the holiday gap recorded.

Promote.
